{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {len(df[df['customer_age'] == -1])}")

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print(f"Unique values in revenue (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {len(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'])}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'])}")

# Check the distribution of channels and customer segments
df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size()"}
